critical_issues: Fixed-a holomorphy does not yield exclusion of all beta>2a by cancellation alone.

Require explicit support/initial-piece treatment and ignore finitely many h=0 scales.
theta>8/9 only makes the partial zero-free strip nonempty; a single such theta does not establish RH by this argument.
